systems.title: Player construction, dimensions and animation
systems.summary: A player is an instance of the library symbol characterMC (id 3268), attached at runtime with attachMovie. Its body clip fqBEfG holds the stick figure and a 3-frame state timeline (idle/walk/run) whose legs sub-clip advances with speed; the arm/weapon clip gfoKHPq holds a 49-frame table of per-weapon idle/run/attack poses.

scripts.what: stick() constructor: all player state and defaults

server: ballistickemu/src/ballistickemu/Tools/StickPacketMaker.java:187 (getClientInfo: uid, name, colour, kills, deaths, wins, losses, rounds, pass, level)

systems.title: Movement, acceleration and tile collision
systems.summary: Movement is a per-frame velocity integration with acceleration toward a per-weapon max speed, friction 0.65, and an 8-way facing encoded as a 2-character string ('1'=up/left, '2'=down/right, '0'=none). Collision is not a tile solver: the client hit-tests the player against a movieclip layer that holds a tileCol<type> shape per visible tile, and reflects velocity by -0.5 on contact. The camera scrolls when the player leaves a 250..300 x 175..225 dead zone, and the world is a 13x10 tile window that is re-populated as the camera moves.

scripts.what: jhzeUQ(): per-axis collision probe, velocity reflection
stick.prototype.move(): input, facing, camera, scroll, timers
reloadTile(): 13x10 window slot mapping and tileCol attach

tiles.note: Collision type is the 6th character of each 6-char tile cell in a .dat file; the client attaches 'tileCol<type>' and hit-tests it (frame_1/DoAction.as:496, reloadTile).

server: The server does not simulate movement: GamePacketBroadcastHandler.java:30 re-broadcasts opcode 1/2/4/5/6/8 verbatim.

systems.title: Weapons, pickups, attacks and damage
systems.summary: 14 weapon slots (0-13) are declared in initializeWeapons() as weaponType records. Melee weapons hit-test a hit area at <=100 px; ranged weapons raycast in 10 px steps and are blocked by collision type 3. Hit resolution is victim-side: the attacker broadcasts opcode 4, every other client checks whether that attack hits its own player, and the victim applies the damage locally and broadcasts opcode 6. Map weapon spawns respawn after the map's per-spawn delay, and picking a weapon shortens spawn protection by 66.6 frames.

scripts.what: qxTtuh(): range gates, hitTest probes, projectile raycast
qxCsEe(): weapon switch, pickup, invuln shortening
mouseUp sets zqyafO=true -> semi-auto weapons re-arm

systems.title: Maps, tile sets and map objects
systems.summary: A map is a plain-text record file: inf=<cols> <rows> <name>, a grid of 6-character tile cells (graphic id, rotation, mirror, collision type), 8 player spawns, 8 weapon spawns (x, y, weapon id, delay) and a tile set index. The editor serialises exactly this format in generateMapString(). Stock maps come from maps/558/<name>; custom maps come from api.php.

scripts.what: loadArea(): metadata, tile grid, spawns, round time, tile set

tiles.note: Collision type is the 6th character of each 6-char tile cell in a .dat file; the client attaches 'tileCol<type>' and hit-tests it (frame_1/DoAction.as:496, reloadTile).

systems.title: Health, death, respawn and scoring
systems.summary: Each player has 60 HP. Damage is an integer subtraction with a HP-bar mask animation; at <=0 the player enters 'dead', plays deathFX, increments deaths, and auto-respawns after 150 frames at a random map spawn point with 133.3 frames of invulnerability. Kills and deaths are packed into two integers (score*13+11 and deaths*11+13) so the client can ship them as compact decimals. Round end awards wins/losses by leaderboard position.

scripts.what: startNextRound(): map cycle rotation, round time

server: Types/StickRoom.java:256-266 (1 s round timer, RoundTime 300, reset at -30)

systems.title: Multiplayer synchronisation
systems.summary: The socket carries null-terminated text. The client sends opcode 1 (position/state) at most every minSendTime ms, plus event packets 4/5/6/7/8; the server relays them to the room. Remote players are reconstructed by re-running the same movement integrator for ping/33+3 frames from the last packet, then lerping with remoteSmoothing=8. The server is a relay, not an authority: it never simulates movement, damage or hits.

systems.title: Lobby, UI and social features
systems.summary: The lobby is main-timeline frame 3 (lobbyFrame) with room list, user list, chat, private messages, VIP list and create/join dialogs. Chat is filtered by com/languagefilter.ini, length-limited and rate-limited per sender. Social systems include ignore list, find-player, vote kick, moderator warn/ban/global message, and a highscore link.

scripts.what: pressCreateGameOK(): room creation and map-cycle options
